line.name: Trinidad x Tommy Bahama Island Collection
line.description: A collaboration between Altadis USA and the Tommy Bahama lifestyle brand, conceived by Rafael Nodal and A.J. Fernandez. IMPORTANT CORRECTION FROM MAC FOLDER NAME: the Mac folder was named 'Trinidad Tommy Breeze,' but research confirms 'Breeze' is a VITOLA within this line, not a standalone line - modeled correctly here as one line with 3 vitolas. Announced for a late-summer/September 2025 launch. Marketed as an 'elegant, relaxed, island-inspired' lifestyle collaboration; medium body.
